lanes.title: Make the sibling 'fails closed without cleanup when a filesystem operation never settles' test deterministic
lanes.description: Linear OVD-639 (follow-up to OVD-638 / PR #601). In scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs the test 'fails closed without cleanup when a filesystem operation never settles' (around lines 560-573) still runs persist against the real 100 ms boundedFilesystem timer in scripts/ovd419-synthetic-acquisition-reader.mjs (lines 70-91, which arm a real setTimeout(min(deadline-now, 30000)) before the I/O microtask). A runner stall at an earlier filesystem step (for example the mkdir) would change the directory-content assertion at line 571. Apply the PR #601 pattern: fake only setTimeout/clearTimeout from before the fixture through cleanup, signal the never-settling operation with a deferred, assert exact counts (timers, pending operations) and the exact failure code; keep the production budget and the fail-closed assertion unchanged. Test-only. ALSO (coordinator-folded one-line doc correction from the PR #600 CodeRabbit summary): in docs/release/jarvis-loop/jev-agent-decisions.md the Limitations paragraph says 'three single-pass runs (the first survives only in commit 2b5ae57, the second at bcbadb2)'; change it to four single-pass runs and add 'the third at 98fe56b' so it matches the Results section above it. No other doc change.
lanes.guidance: Lockfiles follow main (/home/user/Overdrafter/node_modules symlinks). Read PR #601's final test body first and reuse its helper shapes. Red first on a scratch copy: an injected stall before the first filesystem step (the same Atomics.wait technique as #601, placed before the loop polls the I/O) makes the unmodified test fail or pass for the wrong reason; record command and output. Green after the change under the same stall, 20 consecutive runs; a mutant that restores the real budget fails under the stall and passes without it (discriminating). Run npx vitest run scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs, npx vitest run scripts, npm run lint && npm run typecheck, and flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify at the PR boundary. Open a DRAFT PR on main titled 'OVD-639: ...', body per the template. Refer to the acquisition scripts by file name only (never as the release-parent identifier the file prefix resembles); the issue identifiers you may write are OVD-639, OVD-638 and OVD-637; no Linear closing word before an issue id.
lanes.failure_first: Injected early stall makes the unmodified sibling test fail (or pass for the wrong reason) with recorded output; after the change 20/20 under the stall; the real-budget mutant fails under the stall and passes without it.
lanes.verification: npx vitest run scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs (20 iterations under the stall); npx vitest run scripts; npm run lint && npm run typecheck; flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify. Hosted (result of record): test job at the PR head.
